ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Child Care Program
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged fraud in Minnesota's child care program and track the flow of funds
questions: How much money is involved in the alleged fraud?
Who is responsible for the alleged fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. By following the money, we can track the flow of funds and identify potential shell companies or fake claims.
